subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses consonant blends to build up and break down words (r and l blends: bl-ack, fl-op, sl-ip)

show.line: More blends! fr, fr, frog. dr, dr, drum. gr, gr, grass. Listen for the r.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with fr, as in frog?
Listen. dr, u, m. What word is it?
Say the blend with me. gr, as in grass!
Which one starts with cr, as in crab?
Listen. fr, o, g. Tap the word.
Does it start with fr, dr or gr? Sort the pictures.

hints: Say both sounds fast. f, r. fr!
The second sound is r. Hear it growl.

beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot the r. dr, u, m. Drum!
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's blend together. Drr, u, m. Drum!

parent_line: Can hear and blend the r blends fr, dr, gr and cr.
